مَنْفُوسٌ : see نَفِيسٌ, in two places. ＝
-A2- (tropical:) Brought forth; born. (S, M, A, Msb, K.) It is said in a trad., مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ إِلَّا وَقَذْ كُتِبَ مَكَانُهَا مِنَ الجَنَّةِ أَوِ النَّارِ (tropical:) [There is not any soul born but its place in Paradise or Hell has been written]. (S.) ―
-b2- مَنْفُوسَةٌ applied to a woman: see نُفَسَآءُ. ＝
-A3- (tropical:) Smitten with an evil, or envious, eye. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
